label: PROVISIONAL
why_provisional: Rubric froze on a single-annotator MACHINE calibration with no human reviewer, so rubric §11's two-reviewer blinded Cohen's kappa >= 0.70 gate is unmet. The prereg itself records this limit. These numbers are judge-dependent and must not be quoted as human-validated strict GSR.

scoring.method: rubric-rule adjudication (deterministic, offline, zero model calls)
scoring.not_using_production_grounders: rubric §12 forbids using the modified production grounder as its own judge; the ON arm IS that grounder, so both arms are adjudicated by an independent lexical rule instead.
scoring.contradicted_note: Deterministic rules cannot certify incompatibility. A contradiction surfaces as unsupported/cannot_determine; all three labels fail strict GSR, so pass/fail is unaffected.

thresholds_a_priori.note: fixed from rubric §4 wording BEFORE inspecting any arm delta

scoring.acl_axis: true by construction: H1 closed context is single-tenant, no ACL layer

bootstrap.scheme: stratified by (dataset, question_type), clustered by question_id, paired across arms

binding_gate.consequence: strict GSR is a conjunction of four gates, so it equals the gate-1 rate almost exactly (3/348 OFF, 7/348 ON). The ON arm's large grounding advantage (gates 2+3: 0.3132 -> 0.8017) is therefore INVISIBLE in the headline metric. The headline delta is near zero for a structural reason, not because T-G01 does nothing.

grounding_contract_diagnostic.why: strict GSR is the conjunction of FOUR gates; gate 1 is near zero for harness-shape reasons, so the four-gate metric has almost no power here. Gates 2+3 are the grounding contract T-G01 changes.

threshold_disclosure: The a-priori supports threshold (0.80) happens to be the MOST FAVOURABLE point in the sensitivity grid: the delta is 0.0115 at 0.60/0.70/0.80 but falls to 0.0086 at 0.90 and 0.0029 at 1.00. The threshold was fixed from rubric §4 wording before any arm delta was inspected and was NOT tuned, but the headline delta should be read as the upper end of this grid, not as a threshold-independent estimate.

caveats: Gate 1 (reference-correct core answer) is the binding constraint and it is depressed by HARNESS SHAPE, not model quality: the draft prompt elicits a sentence-form answer while HotpotQA gold answers are short spans, so official EM is structurally near zero. Strict GSR is a conjunction of four gates, so a near-zero gate-1 forces strict GSR near zero in BOTH arms and compresses the measurable contrast. Read the gate attribution and the T-E01 deterministic metrics (answer F1, citation validity, paragraph-level support F1) as the informative signals; strict GSR here is a floor, not a discriminator.
No attempt is excluded, quarantined or re-labelled. Denominators are 348 in both arms, exactly as at unblinding.
